title: callista coelogyne
intro: Callista coelogyne, commonly known as the Coelogyne pandurata, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Callista coelogyne include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
